t: This is Dean Trench Street, a short street in the City of Westminster. It takes its name from Richard Chenevix Trench, who lived from 1807 to 1886. He was an Anglican archbishop and a poet, and he was Irish. The name is the connection here, so when you see the street sign, that is the man it remembers. I don't have more detail about the street itself, so I'll leave it there.
